reader.requirement: At --std 85, JUSTIFIED (either spelling) must be refused on any item whose category is numeric (any PICTURE of 9/P/S/V, any usage) or edited (numeric-edited, or alphanumeric-edited with B/0/slash, which at 85 includes A with insertion symbols because §1985:VI.5.9.4 GR2 makes alphabetic all 'A'). It must stay accepted on alphabetic and alphanumeric items. 85 has no national or boolean category.

edition-consulted.switches: picture-string limits and symbol folding that fix the category JustifiedViolation reads. Category assignment for A/X/9/B/0/slash and the numeric-edited symbols is the same at 85 and 2023

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel|CobolVersion in CheckClauseSubjectsPass.cs: only the SYNCHRONIZED arm reads it. JustifiedViolation has no edition parameter
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the predicate (category alphanumeric/national/boolean with no edit mask) is the same at every edition. At 85 only the alphanumeric/alphabetic part can be reached
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb518_clause_placement_legal is an acceptance case only. No refusal of a numeric or edited subject is exercised.

probes.printed: COBOL2405 on N1 9(3) JUST, N2 S9V9 JUSTIFIED RIGHT, N3 9(4) COMP JUST, N4 99PP JUSTIFIED (numeric); E1 ZZ9, E2 $$9.99, E6 9B9 (numeric-edited); E3 XXBX, E4 X/X, E5 A0A (alphanumeric-edited)
probes.expected: every numeric and every edited subject refused (§1985:VI.5.6.3 SR3)
alphabetic A(4) and alphanumeric X9X(2), X(3) accepted and right-justified

probes.printed: E5 PIC A0A JUST refused as alphanumeric-edited
probes.expected: at 85 an A picture with an insertion symbol is alphanumeric edited (§1985:VI.5.9.4 GR2, GR5), so JUSTIFIED is refused

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.6.3 SR3  (5.6.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR3
OK  §1985:VI.5.9.4 GR2  (5.9.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2
OK  §1985:VI.5.9.4 GR5  (5.9.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR5

reader.notes: JustifiedViolation refuses any item whose category is not alphanumeric (which covers A and X) or that has an edit mask, so numeric, numeric-edited and alphanumeric-edited subjects all draw COBOL2405. Recovery clears the flag over CompositionForest. The diagnostic cites the §2023 SR3 text, but the enforced set is exactly the one the 1985 rule names.

refuter.evidence: rju2 (--std 85 compile-only, CURRENCY SIGN IS "W" and DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA): COBOL2405 on ABA and AAB (alphanumeric-edited at 85: alphabetic is 'A' only, §1985:VI.5.9.4 GR2 - the B case the reader did not probe), WWW9 (custom currency), ZZ,99 and 9.999 under DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA, +++9, -ZZ9, 9(3)CR, **9, XX0, P9, S9, 9 PACKED-DECIMAL; OK1 PIC A JUST and OK2 PIC X9 JUST accepted. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.5.6.3 SR3; OK §1985:VI.5.9.4 GR2.
